Title: Rhinitis Medicamentosa: Why Quitting Nasal Spray Feels Impossible

Description:
Past three to five days of daily decongestant spray, nasal blood vessels stop responding the same way and swelling snaps back harder once the drug wears off — that's rhinitis medicamentosa, and it's exactly why quitting outright feels impossible for most people.

A steroid nasal spray works on inflammation instead of squeezing blood vessels, so it cushions the withdrawal without causing rebound. If tapering still isn't enough after weeks of trying, in-office procedures exist specifically for this.
